tasks.task: Rewrite a batch of Etsy listings

items.when: When up to 15 listings need new titles, tags, attributes and description openings in one go
When one listing needs the full rewrite: title, 13 tags, attributes and a description buyers read
When you want a second draft of title and description from the same facts to compare
When a listing is drafted, to score it and get a ranked list of title and tag fixes
When a description could fit any shop, to test it and get a true, picturable rewrite
When a listing is full of praise words and needs plain facts a buyer can check

tasks.task: Build a shop-wide tag and keyword plan

items.when: When you have the shop's own search terms and need phrases grouped by product and buyer need
When you need to see who ranks for a phrase on Etsy, at what price, before you choose it
When the shop's own terms are few, to draw more candidate phrases from buyer messages and reviews
When a long phrase list must be grouped by what the buyer wants: a gift, a style, an occasion
When the plan copies rival tags and nobody has asked what this shop's own buyers type

tasks.task: Audit tags across the shop and cut the wasted ones

items.when: When tags have empty slots, single words, repeats of attributes or phrases that never bring orders
When the wasted tags are found and each slot needs a better phrase from the plan
When one key listing needs its title and tags scored after the changes

tasks.task: Group listings into sections and pick featured items

items.when: When listings need grouping the way buyers shop and four must be chosen to feature
When section names are drafted, to rate each label and rewrite the ones buyers would not get

tasks.task: Audit the whole shop and rank the fixes

items.when: When the owner wants one ranked fix list across search, photos, sections, shipping and policies
When the top listings each need a score so the audit can show before and after
When the audit reaches photos and you need every fault with one fix each
When return and shipping policy text has gaps, clashes or unclear wording
When the owner asks how the shop stands against two or three named rival shops

tasks.task: Plan and review Etsy Ads

items.when: When the owner wants to know which listings to advertise, the daily budget and a keep or stop rule
Before any budget, to find each listing's true margin and the ad return it must reach
At the 30-day review, to test the sums behind each keep or stop call

tasks.task: Launch a new listing or product range

items.when: When a new product is ready to list, with photos taken and the owner's facts written down
Before a new product type is listed, to check how it was made is declared the right way
When the new listing needs its title, tags, attributes and description written
When the photos are not taken yet and the owner needs a shot list with a reason for each
When you need what makes a buyer look for this item and what proof settles their doubt

tasks.task: Plan and check listing photos

items.when: When you have the product photos and facts and need a plan where each image answers a doubt
When the owner shoots on a phone and needs 8 to 12 photos, each with a job and its own light
When a full set is needed from photos of one real product, with failed frames redone
When the set is done, to list every fault with one fix each and a score
When the first photo is flat and you must decide what it should show and where the light falls

tasks.task: Plan a short listing video

items.when: When the owner has not made video before, to pick a format and get ten opening ideas
When you have product facts and photos and want a short reel with timed captions
When any part of the video or its images was made with AI tools and may need declaring

tasks.task: Check prices against costs and fees

items.when: When a price must cover materials, time, fees, delivery and ads, with three prices to test
When you want a quick hand check of profit on one typical order, with every fee listed
When the owner fears a price rise, to plan one they can undo with three outcome cases
When the item is a download and needs a price, a label and a launch discount

tasks.task: Review shipping profiles and processing times

items.when: When on-time shipping slips, buyers complain about delivery or costs look high
When you need zones and rates worked out from parcel sizes, costs and countries
When the owner asks which countries to open next, with shipping and tax costs for each

tasks.task: Check listings against Etsy's making and AI rules

items.when: After a policy notice, or when a printer, supplier or AI tool is part of how items are made
When a design leans on a character, team, brand or another maker's work
When a title or tag uses a phrase that may be someone's registered mark
When the listing says handmade or natural and nobody has checked the supplier's own claims

tasks.task: Prepare product safety details for a new market

items.when: Before selling a product type into a new country, or when Etsy asks for safety details
When the owner imports materials or ships abroad and needs the rules that apply listed

tasks.task: Run the monthly shop health check

items.when: In the first week of each month, after Etsy's Star Seller check on the 1st
When this month's search terms show tags that brought visits but no orders
When new reviews are in and you need the reasons behind the stars, good and bad
When refunds or cases rose and you need the items behind them and the first fix

tasks.task: Take over an existing shop for a new client

items.when: When a new client hands over a live shop and you need the order of work for the first weeks
In the first week, to get the ranked fix list everything else follows
When you need a side-by-side of rival shops' prices and messages before you set priorities

tasks.task: Write the shop's About, policies and FAQs

items.when: When the About section is empty or stiff and the owner can tell you how they started
When the same buyer questions keep coming and the shop needs them answered once
When the owner has no clear rule on returns for custom or made-to-order items
When the policy text is drafted, to find gaps, clashes and unclear wording

tasks.task: Reply to reviews and plan how to ask for them

items.when: When a batch of reviews needs a specific public reply each, with the risky ones listed
When replies run every week and risky ones must be held for the owner
When the shop has few reviews and needs a fair way and time to ask for them

tasks.task: Draft replies to buyer messages and complaints

items.when: When a buyer asks about an order, a custom request or a delay and needs a clear reply
When a buyer is angry and the reply must fix what it can and promise nothing false
When a buyer writes in another language and needs a reply in it
Before a hard reply is sent, to check its promises, facts and tone

tasks.task: Research rivals and find product gaps

items.when: When you need the listings that rank for a phrase, with their prices and shops
When the owner wants a new product, to find sub-categories with strong search and weak ratings
When you want product ideas drawn from what buyers complain about, each scored
When a trend looks tempting and you must judge if it is real and how long it may last

tasks.task: Plan the shop around gift seasons

items.when: When past sales should decide what to push, what offers to run and what to hold each month
When materials or stock must be bought before a season and you need how much and when
When a seasonal item may not sell out and the owner asks how many to make

tasks.task: Plan simple promotion outside Etsy

items.when: When the owner wants a calendar of post topics drawn from real buyer words
When the calendar is agreed and the posts must be written for each platform
When the owner has a small list of past buyers and wants a weekly email plan
Before choosing channels, to compare two plans that spend the seller's hours and money differently

tasks.task: Plan packaging inserts and a thank-you note

items.when: When the owner wants an insert card, a note and a gift rule that the margin can carry
When a designer or printer needs a clear brief for the box, label or wrap

tasks.task: Open a new Etsy shop

items.when: When someone is starting out and needs listings, photos, a price check and launch steps
When there is a shortlist of shop names and each needs a keep, fix or drop call
When the first listings are in and need sections before the shop opens
When the shop needs a banner and icon the owner can edit later

tasks.task: Set up a digital download or print-on-demand listing

items.when: Before listing, to check the design is the seller's own and the print partner is declared
When the listing must say plainly what the buyer gets: files, sizes, or a printed item
When a download needs a price and a launch discount
When the listing needs a preview image and you want a prompt, exact size and a file plan

always.when: Before any listing or policy text goes live, to catch typos and names spelt two ways
When a listing claims handmade, organic, safe or a result, to sort each claim and reword it
Before listings or shop pages go to the seller, so a fresh reader checks them against what was asked

helpers.when: When the listings need a real photo set planned and shot, not a check of existing photos
When more than 15 listings need full descriptions in the shop's voice
When the shop wants Pinterest pins and boards to bring buyers to its listings
When off-Etsy promotion needs a running social plan, not a one-month calendar
When product safety, labelling or import rules need more than a readiness list
When the packaging needs artwork, a label or a box layout

gaps: No library item works out Etsy's fees per order: listing, transaction, payment and offsite ad fees
No library item reads Etsy Stats: visits, conversion, traffic sources and search terms by listing
No library item plans or reviews Etsy Ads from the ads dashboard; only the kit skill covers it
No library item groups a shop into sections or picks featured listings; only the kit prompt covers it
No library item covers Etsy shipping profiles, processing times or Star Seller measures
No library item checks listings against Etsy's Creativity Standards, AI disclosure or production partner rules
No library item covers product safety duties for handmade goods sold into the EU, UK or US
No library item sets up print-on-demand products or makes honest mockups from a real design file
No library item covers digital download listings: file formats, what the buyer gets and delivery
No library item sets up variations and personalisation fields for made-to-order items
No library item plans Etsy sales and coupons, such as thank-you or abandoned basket offers
No library item gives a gift season calendar for when Etsy buyers start searching for each occasion
No library item writes vintage item descriptions with age, condition and flaws
No English library item checks photos against a marketplace's image rules or swaps a product's background; those that exist are written in Chinese
